name: personal-agent-skills
description: Personal agent skills and a curated third-party skill install list.

scripts.setup: node scripts/install-personal-skills.mjs && node scripts/install-curated-skills.mjs && node scripts/install-agents.mjs
scripts.setup:copy: node scripts/install-personal-skills.mjs --copy && node scripts/install-curated-skills.mjs --copy && node scripts/install-agents.mjs --copy
scripts.verify: npm run skills:list && npm run install:curated:dry-run && node scripts/install-agents.mjs --dry-run
